descriptionPlain:
Zoox is building the future of transportation. To do that, we’re also building an incredible crew—united by our mission, energized by our values, and driven by our purpose. We are looking to hire an executive assistant to support our executive office, reporting to the CEO's EA, and providing rotating support to key executives throughout the organization. This role will work closely with other Executive Assistants and Administrative Business Partners across all the departments at Zoox. This is an ideal position for someone who works well in a fast-paced environment, is a self-starter, and wants to work on dynamic and mission-driven teams.
 
This role will require strong calendaring and prioritization skills, uncompromising attention to detail, the ability to meet tight deadlines, excellent organizational skills, and the ability to juggle multiple critical requests simultaneously. A high level of integrity, discretion in handling confidential information, and professionalism in dealing with senior leaders within the company are also vital aspects of this role. Most importantly, you must have a genuine passion for the Zoox mission.
description:
Zoox is looking to hire an Administrative Business Partner to support our Product, Features, and Homologation department. This role will support the Senior Director of Product, Features, and Homologation and the Director of Product and provide administrative support for team. You will report to the Senior Director. In this position, you will work closely with other Executive Assistants and Administrative Business Partners across all the departments at Zoox.

This role will require strong calendaring and prioritization skills, uncompromising attention to detail, the ability to meet tight deadlines, excellent organizational skills, and the ability to juggle multiple critical requests simultaneously. A high level of integrity and discretion in handling confidential information, and professionalism in dealing with senior leaders within the company are also critical aspects of this role. Most importantly, you must have a genuine passion for the Zoox mission.

lists.content:
• Manage extensive calendar arrangements on a day-to-day basis including scheduling team meetings, cross-functional meetings, interviews, and navigating last-minute schedule changes

  • Lead the preparation, agenda, note-taking and follow-ups for select team meetings and quarterly operations reviews.

  • Plan and execute team off-sites and events varying in size and complexity for org-wide and individual team offsite

  • Help with new hire onboarding for scaling departments

  • Complete administrative tasks including booking domestic and international travel, expense reporting, calendar management, and meeting arrangements

  • Act as a back-up to other Administrative Business Partners and Executive Assistants as needed

• 4+ years of either administrative or executive assistant experience

  • Strong organizational skills and appreciation for the challenges of supporting a growing team of diverse personalities and programs

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Sensitivity to handling critical and confidential information

  • Technical computer skills, including proficiency with Google for Business Suite, MS Office Suite, Keynote, and other Apple product.

• Previous exposure to company boards, public officials, and other senior-level stakeholders

  • Bachelor's degree

salaryDescription:
Base Salary Range
 
There are three major components to compensation for this position: salary, Amazon Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), and Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights. A sign-on bonus may be offered as part of the compensation package. The listed range applies only to the base salary. Compensation will vary based on geographic location and level. Leveling, as well as positioning within a level, is determined by a range of factors, including, but not limited to, a candidate's relevant years of experience, domain knowledge, and interview performance. The salary range listed in this posting is representative of the range of levels Zoox is considering for this position.
 
Zoox also offers a comprehensive package of benefits, including paid time off (e.g. sick leave, vacation, bereavement), unpaid time off, Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights, Amazon RSUs, health insurance, long-term care insurance, long-term and short-term disability insurance, and life insurance.

descriptionPlain:
About Our Internship Program
Zoox's internship program offers hands-on experience with cutting-edge technology, mentorship from some of the industry's brightest minds, and the opportunity to make meaningful contributions to real projects. We seek interns who demonstrate strong academic performance, engagement beyond the classroom, intellectual curiosity, and a genuine interest in Zoox's mission.
Job Description
The Safety Learnings team within Operational Safety helps keep Zoox's autonomous vehicles safe on the road by turning safety-related events into fast, accurate decisions. We apply AI to the pipelines that detect, triage, and resolve these events, working at the intersection of Autonomy and Fleet Operations.
As an AI intern, you will own a scoped project from the first prototype to something the team uses. You will be paired with a mentor, work alongside experienced engineers, and present your results to the broader organization at the end of the summer.

Job Description

The Safety Learnings team within Operational Safety helps keep Zoox's autonomous vehicles safe on the road by turning safety-related events into fast, accurate decisions. We apply AI to the pipelines that detect, triage, and resolve these events, working at the intersection of Autonomy and Fleet Operations.

As an AI intern, you will own a scoped project from the first prototype to something the team uses. You will be paired with a mentor, work alongside experienced engineers, and present your results to the broader organization at the end of the summer.

lists.content:
• Develop AI workflows across Operational Safety that automate manual analysis and speed up how safety events are reviewed.
  • Contribute to auto-triage methodologies for safety-related pipelines, helping classify, prioritize, and route events accurately.
  • Build a pipeline that detects out-of-distribution scenarios and unhuman-like driving behaviors in vehicle data, so they can be assessed for safety impact.
  • Define and test detection criteria, then validate flagged events with engineers and safety analysts to separate real concerns from noise.
  • Evaluate your workflows against real safety data, measure accuracy, and refine them based on what you find.
  • Present your work in team reviews and a final intern showcase, and hand off documented code the team can build on.

• Currently working towards a B.S., M.S., Ph.D., or advanced degree in a relevant engineering program
  • Good academic standing
  • Expected to graduate between Fall 2027 and Summer 2028, and enrolled at an accredited college or university throughout the internship
  • Able to commit to a full-time, 12-week internship beginning in May/June 2027
  • Ability to relocate to the Bay Area, California, for the duration of the internship
  • Interns at Zoox may not use any proprietary information they are working on as part of their thesis, any published work with their university, or to be distributed to anyone outside of Zoox

• Proficiency in Python, including data analysis and scripting to automate workflows
  • Experience building with LLMs or machine learning models (prompting, evaluation, classification), through coursework, projects, or prior work
  • Familiarity with anomaly and out-of-distribution detection, or time-series and behavioral modeling, through coursework or projects
  • Strong SQL and data skills; comfort querying and analyzing large datasets (e.g. Databricks)
  • Familiarity with Git and issue tracking tools such as Jira and Atlassian tools
  • Strong communication skills, attention to detail, and a positive, adaptable, team-first attitude

• Experience with agentic or LLM-based workflow tools and integrations (e.g. Slack, Jira, Confluence)
  • Experience with a business intelligence tool (e.g. Looker, Tableau)
  • Enthusiasm for autonomous vehicles, robotics, or safety-critical systems
